## About
Auto Chek Centers is a test-only smog check station on E Orangethorpe Ave in Anaheim, serving the Anaheim and Fullerton area. Because we only test and don't do repairs, our "Pass or One Free Retest" policy is about giving you an honest, unbiased result.
We can test and certify most vehicles, including hybrids, motorhomes, diesel vehicles and gross polluters. If your car doesn't pass, we give you the test results showing where it fell short, including any trouble codes from your on-board computer.
We're also a registration service, so we can process most California renewals and title transfers and issue tags and registrations onsite. Drivers have given us 4.1 stars across 122 Google reviews.

## Services
- Smog test (2000 & newer): Smog test or pre-inspection for model year 2000 and newer vehicles. ($59.95)
- Smog test (1996 thru 1999): Smog test or pre-inspection for 1996 thru 1999 vehicles. ($69.95)
- Smog test (1976 thru 1995): Smog test or pre-inspection for 1976 thru 1995 vehicles. ($79.95)
- Registration renewal: We process most California registration renewals and issue your tags onsite. ($24.95)
- Title transfer and duplicate title: California title transfers and duplicate title requests. ($44.95)
- Notary service: Notary service while you're here. ($15 per signature)

## FAQ
Q: What happens if my car fails?
A: You get one free retest, good for 30 days from the date of the failed inspection.

Q: Can you test hybrids, diesels and motorhomes?
A: Yes. We can test and certify most vehicles, including hybrids, motorhomes, diesel vehicles and gross polluters.

Q: Are you part of the DMV?
A: No. We're a vehicle registration service, not a branch of the DMV, so not every DMV transaction can be done here.

Q: How can I pay for registration services?
A: Debit, credit card or cash. Checks aren't accepted for registration services.
